title: flashcards-session
prompt:
Mobile screen (iPhone, 393pt wide, dark mode) for "NY RE Exam", a cram app for the New York State real estate salesperson exam: a flashcard review session. Design concept "Wayfinding": the visual language of New York subway signage. Every syllabus topic is a colored circular route bullet with one bold character (red #DA291C "1"/"2", blue #0039A6 "A"/"C", green #00843D "4"/"6", orange #FF6319 "B"/"D", yellow #FCCC0A with dark text "N"/"R", purple #9B2A92 "7", lime #6CBE45 "G"); progress is drawn as a line with station dots. Everything else is quiet, native-iOS polish on a dark OLED canvas.
Typography: Helvetica Neue bold for headings and all numbers (tabular figures, tight -0.02em tracking), system UI for body text. Sentence case everywhere. No all-caps labels, no middle-dot separators, no arrows on buttons, no emoji.
Palette: canvas #090d16, surface #111725, raised #182033, hairline rgba(148,163,184,.16), ink #f1f5f9, secondary ink #a3b1c6, go #10b981, stop #ef4444, caution #f59e0b, statute indigo #818cf8. Elevation by surface lightness, not shadows. Radius: 24 hero, 18 cards, 14 controls, full pills for bullets. Every tap target at least 44pt. Floating glass capsule tab bar at the bottom with 6 tabs (icon over label): Home, Study, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More.
Top: a slim bar with a close (x) icon button on the left, "Card 8 of 24" in bold tabular numerals in the middle, and a small "Listen" speaker icon button on the right; under it a 4px progress line with station dots.
Center: one large flashcard (24 radius, #111725, generous padding) showing the BACK side after a tap-to-flip: at the top a small route bullet (red "1") plus the chapter name "License Law & Article 12-A" in secondary ink; a small muted label "Key number"; the prompt in secondary ink "Maximum DOS fine in lieu of suspension or revocation"; a hairline; then the answer large and bold in green "$2,000"; then a short muted citation line "(RPL §441-c)" in indigo.
Bottom thumb zone, no tab bar on this screen: two large buttons side by side, left tonal dark "Still learning" with a small red dot, right green primary "Got it". Under them a quiet caption "Got it moves the card to the next stop: 1 day, 3 days, then 7 days".
